description: Run this before robyn_prepare/robyn_submit. Returns decision GO or NO_GO plus typed `blockers` (each with a `fix`) and `warnings`. It catches, for free, the failures that otherwise cost gas: a fixed corridor fee that would consume the whole amount so nothing arrives, a recipient in the wrong address family, a corridor that can price but not settle, and a transfer above the instant lane's capacity that would silently pay a dearer bridge. Read-only — signs nothing, moves nothing. Pass fromAddress so membership (free micro-transfers) is recognised.

amount.description: amount in fromToken base units (e.g. "5000000" = 5 USDC)

fromAddress.description: sender — determines membership and therefore fee tier

fromToken.description: symbol or address; omit for the chain default

toAddress.description: recipient — validated against the destination chain family

toChain.description: destination chain id or non-EVM name

name: robyn_preflight
title: Check a transfer will succeed BEFORE spending anything
